thread:
Leah: Quick async standup — embedding cost spike for AcmePay. What I did: looked at logs, confirmed surge started after their config change. Blockers: renewal call tomorrow and need a mitigation ETA for the CS lead. Today: coordinate hotfix + update renewal notes.

Omar: I saw the same. Their batch_size override jumped to 2048 after dedupe rollout. Plan: clamp per-request batch_size at the router layer to 256 as a temporary guard. ETA ~2h. @Priya can CS hold the renewal if we need >2h?

Priya: I can nudge the renewal lead but they want something concrete before 3pm PST. If fix is >2h we should enable a per-customer rate cap as short-term mitigation. Can we flip that remotely?

Omar: Yes — we have an admin toggle. I'll prepare the toggle + runbook. Curl to flip (for runbook):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/admin/caps \ 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \ 
 -d '{\"customer_id\":\"acmepay\",\"embedding_rate_limit\":200}'
```

Leah: Good. Please also add a one-line talking point for renewal: \"We are deploying a temporary rate cap to limit unexpected costs while we stabilize ingestion.\"

Priya: Adding that to renewal doc now. Link: https://docs.redwood/customers/acmepay/renewal-notes :page_with_curl:

Sam: FYI clamping to 256 tokens/batch may increase latency on very long docs. Recommend a short perf canary on staging before prod flip. I can run smoke tests once Omar deploys.

Omar: Agree. Deploying to staging in ~30m and will run a 50-request canary and post latency/cost numbers here.

deploy-bot: release/2026.03.17-emb-cap deployed to staging by Omar — 1745559901

Leah: Awesome. After canary, ping me with perf + cost delta and I’ll brief the renewal lead. Capture the cost estimate (delta vs baseline) if possible.

Priya: One more ask — enable telemetry flag to capture per-request batch_size for 24h so we can confirm root cause and show evidence in renewal call.

Omar: Adding telemetry flag now. Will include the flag name in the runbook.

Sam: I’ll queue the smoke test once the flag and deploy are live. ETA ~45m from now.

Leah: Thanks all. If anything blocks, escalate to #eng-oncall. Note for calendar: renewal call 3pm PST tomorrow — Leah + Priya attending. (reaction :thumbsup:)
